company.name: Understudy
company.position: a private parent company outside the VC-backed idea machine

principles: Quality and durability should reinforce each other.
Understudy is not anti-success; it is anti-generic startup logic.
The places with soul often grow slower because soul is operationally difficult.
The AI CEO must ask before high-impact action.
Define Understudy by the positive thing it is building, not by exaggerated opposition.
Understudy should study the layer around AI models: orchestration, memory, tool access, retrieval, routing, privacy, interfaces, workflows, and specialized local/cloud systems.
Understudy should look for strange early builders, small loyal communities, and tiny products that already feel like worlds.
